Both non-members and members can make a strength potion (4) by providing the [[Apothecary]] in [[Varrock]] with {{NoCoins|5}} coins, a [[limpwurt root]], and [[red spiders' eggs]]. Members who have attained at least level 12 [[Herblore]] additionally have the ability to use a [[limpwurt root]] on a [[tarromin potion (unf)]], yielding a Strength potion(3) and 50 Herblore [[experience]]. A dose of Strength potion provides a [[temporary skill boost]] to [[Strength]] equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down. This is less than the [[super Strength]]'s and [[super combat potion]]'s boost of 5 + 15% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down. After [[Barbarian Training#Barbarian Herblore|Barbarian Herblore Training]], [[roe]] or [[caviar]] can be added to a Strength potion(2), requiring 14 Herblore, yielding a [[Strength mix]] and 17 Herblore experience. A Strength mix has 2 doses, boosts Strength equal to 3 + 10% of the player's current Strength level, rounded down, and heals 3 [[Hitpoints]]. A Strength potion(2) can occasionally be obtained from a chest inside the [[maze]] [[random event]]. A Strength potion(3) can be purchased from the [[Warriors' Guild]] [[Warrior Guild Potion Shop|potion shop]] for {{NoCoins|15}} coins. A Strength potion(4) is a reward from [[Jekyll and Hyde]] [[random event]]s if a [[guam leaf]] is given to Dr Jekyll. If the player talks to Dr Jekyll and does not give a herb, then Dr Jekyll gives a Strength potion(2). Having the Apothecary make a Strength potion is a requirement for completing the medium [[Varrock Diary]] and creating a Strength potion in the [[The Deeper Lode]] pub in [[Lovakengj]] is a requirement for completing the easy [[Kourend & Kebos Diary]]. ==Effects== Strength boost is calculated with: \lfloor StrengthLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor + 3 Stat boosts will decay at a rate of
